0022600175.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 14th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (5-2, 3rd in the East) as they look to snap a three-game losing streak, while Milwaukee has gone 0-3 on the road and Boston is 4-0 at home. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bucks lost 1-3 to Boston in the 2025-26 season, including a 133-101 loss in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026. Kam Jones is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for Milwaukee, while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest), both listed as out.
